experimental_design: Comparison of platelet proteomes between critically diseased COVID-19 patients (ICU and NW) and healthy controls

A comparative proteome analysis of highly purified platelets from critically diseased COVID-19 patients with different outcomes (survivors and non-survivors) and age- and sex-matched controls was performed.
